deals.headline: Thrive Financial Announces $1 Billion Asset Purchase Facility Commitment With TPG

deals.headline: OneMain Financial and TPG Extend and Expand Forward Flow Agreement to Invest in Consumer and Auto Loans

deals.headline: Elevex Capital Announces $1 Billion Forward Flow Agreement With TPG
deals.summary: Equipment finance company Elevex Capital closed a $1 billion forward flow agreement with TPG.
deals.evidence: WESTLAKE, Ohio – January 13, 2026 – Elevex Capital, LLC (“Elevex”), an independent commercial equipment finance company, today announced it has closed on a forward flow agreement with TPG, a leading global alternative asset management firm. The agreement provides Elevex access to $1 billion in capital, enabling the company to originate and fund larger transactions with a dedicated capital partner.

deals.headline: TPG and Lennar Announce Strategic Partnership to Recapitalize Quarterra
deals.summary: TPG Real Estate acquired a majority interest in Lennar's multifamily developer Quarterra, with Lennar keeping a minority stake and TPG making an additional $1 billion strategic commitment.
deals.evidence: San Francisco & Miami – Lennar Corporation (NYSE: LEN and LEN.B) (“Lennar”), one of the nation’s leading homebuilders, and TPG Real Estate (“TPG”) announced today that TPG has acquired a majority interest in Quarterra, an established developer of high-quality multifamily communities that combines institutional scale with local market expertise to deliver thoughtfully designed rental offerings in high-growth markets. Lennar has retained a minority stake in the platform and continues to provide differentiated insights and synergies to Quarterra. TPG has made an additional $1 billion strategic commitment in connection with the acquisition and expects to raise additional capital to fund future growth and the development of Quarterra’s multifamily pipeline, with a focus on Emblem communities—a signature strategy dedicated to the development of attainable, high-quality rental housing options nationwide.

deals.headline: TPG and Jackson Financial Inc. Announce Strategic Partnership to Accelerate Growth
deals.summary: TPG agreed to make a $500 million minority investment for an approximate 6.5% pro forma stake in Jackson Financial as part of a long-term investment management partnership.
deals.evidence: As part of the transaction, TPG will make a $500 million minority investment in Jackson, representing an approximate 6.5% pro forma ownership stake. Jackson will receive $150 million of TPG stock, priced at market, with the potential to receive additional shares if the investment management partnership grows to $20 billion.

deals.headline: TPG Makes Significant Investment in Trustwell, a Market Leader in Supply Chain Software for the Food Industry
deals.summary: TPG's The Rise Funds made a majority investment in food-industry compliance software provider Trustwell, with The Riverside Company fully exiting.
deals.evidence: San Francisco, CA – TPG, a leading global alternative asset management firm, announced today that The Rise Funds, the multi-sector strategy of its global impact investing platform, has made a majority investment in Trustwell, a leading provider of SaaS-based regulatory, compliance, and traceability solutions for the food industry. Following TPG’s investment, The Riverside Company has fully exited its investment in Trustwell.

deals.headline: TPG to Acquire Majority Stake in Conservice
deals.summary: TPG Capital signed a definitive agreement to acquire a majority stake in utility management platform Conservice, with Advent retaining a significant stake and TA fully exiting.
deals.evidence: River Heights, Utah; San Francisco & Fort Worth, Texas; Boston, MA – TPG, a leading global alternative asset management firm, today announced the signing of a definitive agreement to acquire a majority stake in Conservice (the “Company”), a leading utility management platform for the property management industry. TPG will invest in Conservice through TPG Capital, the firm’s U.S. and European private equity platform, and will join leading global private equity investor Advent International, who will retain a significant stake after first investing in Conservice in 2020. In connection with the transaction, TA Associates (“TA”) will fully exit its stake in the business.

deals.headline: Ethos Capital Completes Continuation Vehicle for Identity Digital
deals.summary: Ethos Capital completed a continuation vehicle for Identity Digital bringing in investors including TPG GP Solutions, Neuberger, Accel-KKR and Coller Capital.
deals.evidence: BOSTON – Ethos Capital LP (Ethos) announced today that it has completed a continuation vehicle (CV) transaction for its portfolio company Identity Digital, bringing in institutional investors including TPG GP Solutions, funds managed by Neuberger, Accel-KKR, Coller Capital, CVC Secondary Partners, British Columbia Investment Management Corporation (BCI) and 10 East, among others. The transaction enables Ethos to support Identity Digital’s next stage of growth, while offering existing investors the opportunity for liquidity.

deals.headline: Cencora Finalizes Agreement to Acquire TPG’s Equity Interest in OneOncology
deals.summary: Cencora entered into a definitive agreement to acquire TPG's equity interest in oncology practice platform OneOncology.
deals.evidence: NASHVILLE, TN — Cencora, Inc. today announced it has entered into a deﬁnitive agreement to acquire TPG’s equity interest in OneOncology, a physician-led national platform empowering independent medical specialty practices rooted in oncology.

deals.headline: TPG and MAVCO-led Consortium Completes Acquisition of Siemens Gamesa’s Wind Business in India and Sri Lanka, Forming New Platform Vayona Energy
deals.summary: A TPG and MAVCO-led consortium completed the acquisition of Siemens Gamesa's onshore wind business in India and Sri Lanka, renamed Vayona Energy.
deals.evidence: MUMBAI, 2 December 2025 – Following the successful acquisition of Siemens Gamesa’s onshore wind business in India and Sri Lanka led by global alternative asset management firm TPG and MAVCO, a private company belonging to select member of the Muruguppa family, the newly formed independent company has unveiled its new identity, Vayona Energy.

deals.headline: TPG Makes Strategic Investment in Healthcademia

deals.evidence: TPG’s The Rise Fund joins majority shareholder G Square Capital to accelerate Healthcademia’s Next Phase of Growth Paris, Madrid, San Francisco, London – 20 November 2025 – Healthcademia, a global leader in healthcare education, today announced a significant minority investment from TPG, a leading global alternative asset management firm.

deals.headline: TCS Secures $1Bn Investment from TPG to Accelerate AI Data Center Business HyperVault
deals.summary: TCS partnered with TPG on its AI data center business HyperVault, with TPG to invest up to Rs 8,820 crore of a total Rs 18,000 crore commitment for a 27.5% to 49% stake.
deals.evidence: MUMBAI, INDIA | November 20, 2025: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) (BSE: 532540, NSE: TCS), a global leader in IT services, consulting, and business solutions, has today announced a strategic partnership with TPG, a leading global alternative asset management firm to support the growth of its AI data center business, HyperVault. Both partners combined, will commit to invest up to Rs 18,000 crore over the next few years. Out of the total commitment of up to Rs 18,000 crore, TPG will invest up to Rs 8,820 crore and is envisaged to have final shareholding between 27.5% and 49% in HyperVault.

deals.headline: Pike Corporation to Accelerate Growth through Partnership with TPG, La Caisse and Management
deals.summary: TPG Rise Climate and La Caisse signed a definitive agreement to acquire a majority interest in grid engineering and construction provider Pike Corporation.
deals.evidence: FORT WORTH, TX & SAN FRANCISCO, CA; CHARLOTTE, NC; & MONTREAL, CANADA – November 17, 2025 – TPG, a leading global alternative asset manager, and global investment group La Caisse (formerly CDPQ), today announced that they have partnered with the management team of Pike Corporation, a leading national provider of turnkey infrastructure engineering and construction solutions for the electrical grid, and signed a definitive agreement to acquire a majority interest in Pike. TPG will invest in Pike through TPG Rise Climate, the firm’s dedicated climate investing platform, with La Caisse investing alongside TPG for a significant minority interest.

deals.headline: HALA raises $157m in one of the Middle East’s largest fintech Series B rounds, led by TPG and Sanabil Investments
deals.summary: Saudi fintech HALA raised a $157 million Series B co-led by TPG's The Rise Fund and Sanabil Investments.
deals.evidence: Riyadh, Saud Arabia — 15 September 2025 : HALA Holding, Saudi Arabia’s leading fintech and provider of embedded financial services to micro, small and medium enterprises, has raised $157 million in a Series B investment round — officially one of the largest fintech Series B funding rounds in the Middle East. The funding round is led by The Rise Fund, TPG’s multi-sector global impact investing strategy, and Sanabil Investments, a wholly owned company by the Public Investment Fund (PIF), with participation from QED, Raed Ventures, Impact 46, Middle East Venture Partners (MEVP), Isometry Capital, Arzan VC, BNVT Capital, Kaltaire Investments, Endeavor Catalyst, Nour Nouf Ventures, Khwarizmi Ventures, and Wamda Capital.

(NYSE: GEV) and TPG, a leading global alternative asset management firm, announced today the signing of a binding agreement confirming the intent under which TPG will acquire GE Vernova’s Proficy® manufacturing software business (“Proficy”) for $600 million. GE Vernova may receive additional sale proceeds in the future depending on various outcomes and conditions.

deals.headline: JVP Closes $290 Million Continuation Vehicle in Partnership with TPG to Power Earnix’s AI Transformation of the Global Insurance Industry
deals.summary: JVP closed a $290 million single-asset continuation vehicle for insurance AI company Earnix in partnership with TPG GP Solutions.

deals.headline: Tessolve, a Hero Electronix venture raises $150 million from TPG
deals.summary: Hero Electronix semiconductor engineering services company Tessolve raised $150 million from TPG.
deals.evidence: New Delhi, 1 st September 2025: Tessolve, a Hero Electronix venture and the largest independent semiconductor engineering services company globally today announced it has secured $150 million in funding from leading global alternative asset management firm TPG.

deals.headline: TPG to Acquire Irth Solutions from Blackstone
deals.summary: TPG Growth agreed to acquire energy and infrastructure software provider Irth Solutions from Blackstone Energy Transition Partners.
deals.evidence: San Francisco & Columbus, Ohio – August 26, 2025 – Irth Solutions (“Irth”), a leading provider of enterprise software for critical energy and infrastructure companies, today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by TPG, a leading global alternative asset management firm. TPG will acquire Irth through TPG Growth, the firm’s middle market and growth equity platform, from Blackstone Energy Transition Partners (“Blackstone”).

deals.headline: Vanara Capital Announces Firm Launch and Strategic Partnership with TPG
deals.summary: Growth-stage tech investor Vanara Capital launched with TPG NEXT as a significant anchor investor in its inaugural fund.

As part of the partnership, TPG NEXT will serve as a significant anchor investor in Vanara’s inaugural fund, joining a roster of notable investors and industry executives including Greg Williams, Co-Founder, Chairman, and CEO of Acrisure, a leading global financial services and technology platform.

deals.headline: Great Hill Partners Announces Growth Investment in Blue Cloud Pediatric Surgery Centers
deals.summary: Great Hill Partners acquired a majority interest in Blue Cloud Pediatric Surgery Centers from TPG's The Rise Fund.

deals.headline: Francisco Partners to Acquire Legal Tech Solutions Provider Elite from TPG
deals.summary: Francisco Partners agreed to acquire legal software provider Elite from TPG Capital and Thomson Reuters; terms were not disclosed.

Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

deals.headline: Partners Group and a consortium of minority investors, including GIC, TPG Rise Climate, and Mubadala, to invest in next growth phase at Techem

deals.summary: At the close of TPG Capital's acquisition of Sabre's Hospitality Solutions business, hotel owner-operator MCR made a strategic minority investment in the company.
deals.evidence: San Francisco & Fort Worth, Texas — July 7, 2025 — Hospitality Solutions, a leading hospitality technology provider, today announced the completion of its previously announced acquisition by TPG, a leading global alternative asset management firm. Alongside the transaction close, Hospitality Solutions has received a strategic minority investment from MCR, the third largest owner-operator of hotels in the United States, who will bring additional, specialized hospitality expertise.

deals.headline: TPG Completes Acquisition of Peppertree Capital Management
deals.summary: TPG completed its acquisition of wireless tower investor Peppertree Capital Management, a $7.8 billion strategy now operating as TPG Peppertree.
deals.evidence: San Francisco; Fort Worth, Texas & Chagrin Falls, Ohio – July 2, 2025 – TPG Inc. (NASDAQ: TPG), a leading global alternative asset management firm, today announced the successful completion of its previously announced acquisition of Peppertree Capital Management (“Peppertree”). Moving forward, the $7.8 billion strategy will operate as TPG Peppertree and will continue to be led by Howard Mandel and Ryan Lepene as Co-Managing Partners.

deals.headline: TPG Rise Climate Acquires Aurora Energy Research from CGE Partners
deals.summary: TPG Rise Climate agreed to acquire a majority stake in energy analytics firm Aurora Energy Research from CGE Partners.

Aurora’s CEO, John Feddersen will also make a substantial investment alongside 22C Capital.

deals.headline: Renaissance Partners and TPG Rise Climate Enter Into a Binding Agreement to Jointly Acquire Control of SICIT
deals.summary: Renaissance Partners and TPG Rise Climate signed a binding agreement to jointly acquire a controlling stake in Italian biostimulant maker SICIT.

(“SICIT” or the “Company”), a global leader in the production of biostimulants, transforming the residues of the leather industry into high value-added products for sustainable agriculture through a fully circular business model. In the context of the transaction, the current shareholders, Renaissance Partners and Intesa Holding, will sell their entire stakes, with Renaissance Partners— through Renaissance Partners Fund IV —reinvesting in the new transaction. Alongside Renaissance Partners and TPG, the major co-investors in this transaction include LGT Capital Partners and Schroders Capital.

deals.headline: AvidXchange Agrees to be Acquired by TPG in Partnership with Corpay for $2.2 Billion
deals.summary: AvidXchange agreed to be taken private by TPG Capital in partnership with Corpay for $10.00 per share, valuing it at $2.2 billion.

deals.headline: Sabre enters into definitive agreement to sell its Hospitality Solutions business unit to TPG for $1.1 billion

deals.headline: Ardabelle Capital Announces Strategic Partnership with TPG NEXT
deals.summary: European mid-market private equity firm Ardabelle Capital announced a strategic partnership and anchor fund commitment from TPG NEXT.
deals.evidence: Paris, San Francisco, and Fort Worth, Texas – April 24, 2025 – Ardabelle Capital (“Ardabelle”), a private equity firm focused on accelerating the transition to a sustainable, resilient economy, today announced a strategic partnership and anchor fund commitment from TPG NEXT, TPG’s strategy focused on seeding and scaling the next generation of investment firms.

deals.headline: TPG and Temasek Join TA to Bolster Cliffwater’s Continued Expansion
deals.summary: TPG Growth and Temasek agreed to make a substantial minority investment in alternative investment adviser Cliffwater alongside existing investor TA Associates.
deals.evidence: BOSTON & SAN FRANCISCO –TPG (NASDAQ: TPG), a leading global alternative asset management firm, and Temasek, a global investment company headquartered in Singapore, today announced a definitive agreement to make a substantial minority investment in Cliffwater LLC (“Cliffwater” or “the Firm”), an independent alternative investment adviser and fund manager. deals.headline: TPG-Backed Crunch Fitness Announces Strategic Investment from Leonard Green & Partners
deals.summary: Leonard Green & Partners agreed to acquire a majority interest in Crunch Fitness from TPG Growth and minority shareholders.

deals.headline: Home care disrupter Five Good Friends secures TPG as strategic growth investor

deals.headline: Elevated Materials Launches to Revolutionize Battery Performance

deals.headline: Cohere Capital Announces Close of Fund II and Strategic Partnership with TPG

The firm has also received a strategic minority investment from TPG NEXT, TPG’s strategy focused on seeding and scaling the next generation of investment firms.

deals.evidence: Austin; San Francisco; Fort Worth, Texas; and Boston – November 10, 2020 – TPG Capital, the private equity platform of global alternative asset firm TPG, and TA Associates, a leading global growth private equity firm, today announced that they have signed a definitive agreement to acquire Planview, a global leader in Portfolio Management and Work Management. TPG Capital and TA Associates will acquire the company for a purchase price of $1.6 billion. Planview’s existing majority shareholder, Thoma Bravo, will retain a minority interest in the company.

deals.headline: Viking Cruises Announces Additional Investment from TPG and CPP Investments
deals.summary: Existing minority shareholders TPG Capital and CPP Investments made an additional investment in Viking providing about US$500 million of net proceeds.
deals.evidence: Los Angeles; San Francisco; Fort Worth, Texas; and Toronto – November 9, 2020 – Viking Cruises announced today an additional investment by its existing minority shareholders, TPG Capital and Canada Pension Plan Investment Board (CPP Investments), in Viking Holdings Ltd, the parent company of Viking Cruises. The additional investment by TPG Capital, the private equity platform of alternative asset firm TPG, and CPP Investments, a professional investment management organization that manages the funds of the Canada Pension Plan, will result in approximately US$500 million of net proceeds being available to support Viking Cruises in its continued development.

deals.headline: TPG Sells LLamasoft to Coupa Software
deals.summary: TPG Capital sold supply chain software company LLamasoft to Coupa Software for approximately $1.5 billion.
deals.evidence: San Francisco; Fort Worth, Texas; and Ann Arbor, Michigan – November 3, 2020 – TPG Capital, the private equity platform of global alternative asset firm TPG, today announced that it has sold LLamasoft, a leader in AI-powered supply chain design and planning, to Coupa Software (NASDAQ: COUP) for a purchase price of approximately $1.5 billion. LLamasoft’s other investors included Goldman Sachs and MK Capital.

deals.seller: TPG Capital and Patriot Media Management
deals.headline: Stonepeak Announces Agreement to Acquire Astound Broadband from TPG for $8.1 Billion
deals.summary: Stonepeak agreed to acquire US cable operator Astound Broadband (RCN, Grande, Wave, enTouch) from TPG Capital and Patriot Media for $8.1 billion.
deals.evidence: PRINCETON, N.J.—November 1, 2020 – Stonepeak Infrastructure Partners (Stonepeak), a private equity firm specializing in infrastructure investing, today announced it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Astound Broadband (Astound), the sixth largest U.S. cable operator in the United States that operates leading regional providers RCN, Grande, Wave and enTouch. Stonepeak will acquire the company from TPG Capital and Patriot Media Management for $8.1 billion.

deals.headline: TPG Backs Leading Better-for-You Candy Brand SmartSweets
deals.summary: TPG Growth took a majority stake in better-for-you candy brand SmartSweets from management and other shareholders.
deals.evidence: San Francisco; Fort Worth, Texas; and Vancouver, British Columbia – October 27th, 2020 – TPG Growth, the middle market and growth equity platform of alternative asset firm TPG, today announced that it has taken a majority stake in SmartSweets (the “Company”), a Vancouver-based better-for-you candy brand on a mission to kick sugar. TPG Growth received its stake from the Company’s management and other shareholders.

deals.headline: Bayer Acquires Asklepios BioPharmaceutical to Broaden Innovation Base in Cell and Gene Therapy
deals.summary: Bayer agreed to acquire gene therapy company AskBio, in which TPG Capital was a minority shareholder, for $2 billion upfront plus up to $2 billion in milestones.
deals.evidence: Berlin, Germany and Research Triangle Park, N.C. – October 26, 2020 – Bayer AG and Asklepios BioPharmaceutical, Inc. (AskBio) today announced an agreement under which Bayer will acquire AskBio, a U.S.-headquartered biopharmaceutical company specializing in the research, development and manufacturing of gene therapies across different therapeutic areas. Under the terms of the agreement, Bayer will pay upfront consideration of USD 2 billion and potential success-based milestone payments of up to USD 2 billion. AskBio’s existing minority shareholders, TPG Capital and Vida Ventures , supported the transaction.

deals.headline: TPG to Invest ₹ 1,837.5 Crore in Reliance Retail Ventures
deals.summary: TPG agreed to invest Rs 1,837.5 crore in Reliance Retail Ventures for a 0.41% stake at a pre-money equity value of Rs 4.285 lakh crore.
deals.evidence: Mumbai, October 2, 2020: Reliance Industries Limited (“Reliance Industries”) and Reliance Retail Ventures Limited (“RRVL”) announced today that global investment firm TPG will invest ₹ 1,837.5 crore into RRVL, a subsidiary of Reliance Industries. This investment values Reliance Retail at a pre-money equity value of ₹ 4.285 lakh crore. TPG’s investment will translate into a 0.41% equity stake in RRVL on a fully diluted basis.

deals.headline: TPG Forms Ellodi Pharmaceuticals to Continue Clinical Development of APT-1011 for Treatment of Eosinophilic Esophagitis
deals.summary: TPG Capital formed Ellodi Pharmaceuticals to develop an eosinophilic esophagitis asset spun out of Adare Pharmaceuticals.
deals.evidence: San Francisco and Fort Worth, Texas –September 22, 2020 – TPG Capital, the private equity platform of alternative asset firm TPG, announced today that it has formed a new specialty pharmaceutical company called Ellodi Pharmaceuticals. The formation of Ellodi Pharmaceuticals follows TPG Capital’s sale of Adare’s specialty CDMO pharmaceutical technology and microbiome businesses to Thomas H. Lee Partners and Frazier Healthcare Partners.

deals.headline: Thomas H. Lee Partners and Frazier Healthcare Partners Acquire Adare
deals.summary: Thomas H. Lee Partners and Frazier Healthcare Partners acquired Adare Pharmaceuticals' CDMO business from TPG Capital.
deals.evidence: Boston and Seattle – September 22, 2020 – Thomas H. Lee Partners, L.P. (“THL”) and Frazier Healthcare Partners (“Frazier”) today announced they have acquired Adare Pharmaceuticals, which will be rebranded Adare Pharma Solutions (“Adare”), a leading specialty contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) and global provider of advanced pharmaceutical technologies, from TPG Capital. The acquisition includes Adare’s CDMO, pharmaceutical technology and microbiome businesses, while TPG Capital will retain rights to Adare’s Eosinophilic Esophagitis (EoE) product, which has been spun out into a separate entity.

deals.headline: Asia’s plant-based food leader Green Monday Holdings raises US$70 million from global investors to accelerate growth
deals.summary: Plant-based food company Green Monday Holdings raised US$70 million led by TPG's The Rise Fund and Swire Pacific.
deals.evidence: 22 September 2020, Hong Kong SAR, China – Green Monday Holdings (“the Company”), Asia’s plant-based food leader, today announced that it has raised US$70 million in financing led by TPG’s The Rise Fund and Swire Pacific Limited.

deals.headline: TPG To Invest ₹ 4,546.80 CRORE in JIO Platforms
deals.summary: TPG agreed to invest Rs 4,546.80 crore in Jio Platforms for a 0.93% stake at an equity value of Rs 4.91 lakh crore and enterprise value of Rs 5.16 lakh crore.
deals.evidence: Mumbai, June 13, 2020 : Reliance Industries Limited (“Reliance Industries”) and Jio Platforms Limited (“Jio Platforms”), India’s leading digital services platform, announced today that global alternative asset firm TPG will invest ₹ 4,546.80 crore in Jio Platforms at an equity value of ₹ 4.91 lakh crore and an enterprise value of ₹ 5.16 lakh crore. The investment will translate into a 0.93% equity stake in Jio Platforms on a fully diluted basis for TPG.

deals.headline: WellSky gains new investment from TPG and Leonard Green & Partners to advance technology innovation in post-acute and community care
deals.summary: TPG Capital agreed to add Leonard Green & Partners as a new capital partner in WellSky, with TPG making a new equity investment.
deals.evidence: OVERLAND PARK, Kan. and SAN FRANCISCO — July 20, 2020 — WellSky , a global health and community care technology company, and TPG Capital , the private equity platform of alternative asset firm TPG, announced today they have entered into a definitive agreement to add Leonard Green & Partners, L.P. (LGP), a private equity firm, as a new capital partner. As part of the transaction, TPG Capital will make a new equity investment in WellSky.

deals.headline: TPG Launches Matrix Renewables with The Rise Fund’s Acquisition of 1GW of Solar PV Projects from Trina Solar
deals.summary: TPG's The Rise Fund acquired about 1 GW of solar PV projects from Trina Solar to launch the Matrix Renewables platform.
deals.evidence: 1 July 2020 – San Francisco, CA; Fort Worth, TX; London, UK; Madrid, Spain – The Rise Fund, a global impact investing fund managed by alternative asset firm TPG, today announced the acquisition of approximately 1 gigawatt (GW) of solar PV projects from Changzhou, China-based Trina Solar (SHA:688599). The solar PV projects included in the transaction are currently operational, under construction or in late stage development nearing ready-to-build status across Spain, Chile, Colombia, and Mexico, and will serve as the first solar PV projects within the portfolio of newly created, Madrid-based Matrix Renewables.

deals.headline: LifeStance Health Partners with TPG, Summit Partners, and Silversmith to Expand Behavioral Health Access
deals.summary: TPG Capital joined existing investors Summit Partners and Silversmith in a partnership providing growth capital to LifeStance Health.
deals.evidence: Bellevue, WA – April 16, 2020 – LifeStance Health (LifeStance), a leading provider of outpatient behavioral health services in the United States, announced today that TPG Capital will join existing investors, Summit Partners and Silversmith Capital Partners, in a partnership to support the company in expanding patient access to high-quality outpatient behavioral health services. Alongside management, TPG, Summit, and Silversmith will provide additional growth capital to support LifeStance’s goal of serving a larger patient population with clinical excellence.

deals.headline: Toast Announces $400M in Series F Funding
deals.summary: Restaurant platform Toast raised a $400 million Series F led by Bessemer, TPG, Greenoaks and Tiger Global at a $4.9 billion valuation.
deals.evidence: Toast valued at $4.9B BOSTON – February 14, 2020 – Toast, the fastest-growing restaurant management platform in the U.S., today announced a $400M Series F funding round led by Bessemer Venture Partners, TPG, Greenoaks Capital, and Tiger Global Management with participation from Durable Capital Partners LP, TCV, funds and accounts advised by T. Rowe Price Associates, G Squared, Light Street Capital, Alta Park Capital, and others.

deals.headline: Fender® Musical Instruments Corporation Announces Change in Ownership, Servco Pacific Inc. to Secure Majority Stake
deals.summary: Servco Pacific agreed to acquire TPG Growth's shares in Fender Musical Instruments, securing a majority stake.
deals.evidence: (JANUARY 27, 2020) — Fender Musical Instruments Corporation (FMIC) today announced Servco Pacific Inc. (Servco) and TPG Growth have entered into a sale and purchase agreement in which Servco will acquire TPG’s shares in the company.

deals.headline: Evercare Platform and CDC Expand to Bangladesh
deals.summary: Evercare and CDC Group agreed to acquire a controlling interest in Bangladesh hospital operator STS Holdings through the Evercare Health Fund.
deals.evidence: January 26, 2020 – DHAKA, Bangladesh, DUBAI and LONDON – Evercare and CDC Group (CDC) today announced an agreement to acquire a controlling interest in STS Holdings Ltd (STS). The investment, made through the Evercare Health Fund, includes financing from CDC Group, the United Kingdom’s impact investor and Development Finance Institution, and support from The Rise Funds.

deals.seller: Company management and The Firmament Group
deals.headline: TPG to Acquire Denali Water Solutions
deals.summary: TPG Growth signed a definitive agreement to acquire organics recycling company Denali Water Solutions from management and The Firmament Group.
deals.evidence: San Francisco; Fort Worth, Texas; and Russellville, Arkansas – January 23, 2020 – TPG Growth, the middle market and growth equity platform of alternative asset firm TPG, today announced that it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Russellville, Arkansas-based Denali Water Solutions (“Denali” or “the Company”) from the Company’s management and The Firmament Group. Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.

deals.headline: Kelsey-Seybold Clinic Partners with TPG, Plans Expansion of Accountable Care Model
deals.summary: TPG Capital made a non-controlling strategic investment in Kelsey-Seybold Management Services, the MSO of the Houston physician group.
deals.evidence: HOUSTON, FORT WORTH, TEXAS, and SAN FRANCISCO (Jan. 21, 2020) – Kelsey-Seybold Clinic (Kelsey-Seybold), the nation’s first Accredited Accountable Care Organization recognized by the National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA), announced today a strategic partnership with TPG Capital, the private equity platform of global alternative asset firm TPG. TPG Capital has made a non-controlling, strategic investment in Kelsey-Seybold Management Services, the management services organization serving the Kelsey-Seybold Medical Group.

deals.headline: CollabNet VersionOne and XebiaLabs Combine to Create Integrated Agile DevOps Platform
deals.summary: TPG Capital-backed CollabNet VersionOne merged with release orchestration company XebiaLabs.
deals.evidence: • Transaction, backed by TPG Capital, marks a transformational step in a broader strategy to create a leading, integrated Agile DevOps platform for enterprises Atlanta and Boston – January 21, 2020 – CollabNet VersionOne (CollabNet), a leading provider for Agile planning and collaborative development, and XebiaLabs, the leader in release orchestration, deployment, and continuous delivery, announced today that the two companies have merged.

deals.target: Summit Permian Transmission Holdco (Double E Pipeline)
deals.headline: Summit Midstream Partners, LP Announces Agreement with TPG for Financing Solution of Double E Pipeline
deals.summary: TPG Energy Solutions agreed to buy up to $80 million of redeemable preferred interests in Summit Midstream's Double E Pipeline holding company.
deals.evidence: The Woodlands, Texas – December 30, 2019 – Summit Midstream Partners, LP (NYSE: SMLP) announced today that it has entered into agreements with TPG, a global alternative asset firm (“TPG”), for the purchase of up to $80 million of redeemable, preferred interests in Summit Permian Transmission Holdco, LLC (“Permian Holdco”), a newly created, unrestricted subsidiary of SMLP that indirectly owns SMLP’s 70% interest in Double E Pipeline, LLC (“Double E”). In connection with the transaction, TPG will fund the next $80 million of Permian Holdco’s capital calls associated with Double E. The investment by TPG will be made by TPG Energy Solutions (“TES”), the firm’s energy-specific structured equity vehicle.

deals.headline: In its first investment into Indian clean energy, Bank of America extends 356.5 crore inr (50 million USD equivalent) local currency revolving credit facility to Fourth Partner Energy
deals.summary: Bank of America extended a Rs 356.5 crore local currency revolving credit facility to Rise Fund-backed Fourth Partner Energy.
deals.evidence: In its first investment into Indian clean energy, Bank of America extends 356.5 crore inr (50 million USD equivalent) local currency revolving credit facility to Fourth Partner Energy NEW YORK & HYDERABAD – December 16, 2019 – In an important step forward for India’s renewable energy growth story, Fourth Partner Energy, one of the country’s largest distributed solar companies, announced today that Bank of America is providing a local currency revolving credit facility.

deals.headline: TPG Leads $33 Million Equity Investment in Ess Kay Fincorp
deals.summary: TPG Growth, Norwest and Evolvence India led a $33 million (Rs 235 crore) equity investment in Indian NBFC Ess Kay Fincorp.
deals.evidence: Mumbai – November 26, 2019 – TPG Growth, a middle-market and growth equity platform of alternative asset firm TPG; Norwest Venture Partners, a multi-stage growth investment fund; and Evolvence India, a leading India focused Private Equity platform, together have led a $33 million (Rs 235 crores) equity investment in Ess Kay Fincorp, a non-bank finance company. The current round was fully subscribed by the existing investors.

deals.headline: The Rise Fund invests in Uganda’s Pearl Dairy
deals.summary: TPG's The Rise Fund invested in Pearl Dairy, Uganda's largest dairy processor.
deals.evidence: Mbarara, Uganda; San Francisco; and Forth Worth, Texas – November 7, 2019 – The Rise Fund, a global impact investment fund managed by TPG that is committed to achieving positive social and environmental outcomes alongside competitive financial returns, has invested in Pearl Dairy.

deals.headline: Hong Leong Group and TPG Announce Agreement to Acquire Columbia Asia Hospitals in South East Asia
deals.summary: Hong Leong Group and TPG agreed to acquire Columbia Asia's Southeast Asian hospitals in a transaction estimated at USD 1.2 billion.
deals.evidence: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia — Malaysia based conglomerate Hong Leong Group and global alternative asset firm TPG announced today that they have entered into a definitive share purchase agreement to acquire Columbia Asia Hospitals in South East Asia. The transaction, estimated at USD 1.2 billion, is expected to close at the end of 2019.

deals.headline: TPG Partners with Convey Health Solutions
deals.summary: TPG Capital acquired health plan solutions provider Convey Health Solutions from New Mountain Capital.
deals.evidence: Fort Lauderdale, FL; San Francisco; and Fort Worth, Texas – September 5, 2019 – TPG Capital, the private equity platform of global alternative asset firm TPG, announced today it has acquired Convey Health Solutions (Convey), a leading provider of technology-enabled and advisory solutions for health plans, from New Mountain Capital (New Mountain). Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

deals.headline: TPG Acquires CollabNet VersionOne
deals.summary: TPG Capital agreed to acquire CollabNet VersionOne from Vector Capital as the first step of committing up to $500 million to build a DevOps platform.
deals.evidence: San Francisco; Fort Worth, Texas; and Atlanta – September 4, 2019 – TPG Capital, the private equity platform of global alternative asset firm TPG, announced today it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire CollabNet VersionOne (“CollabNet”), a leading platform provider for Agile planning, DevOps, and Value Stream Management (VSM), from Vector Capital. The investment marks the first step in a broader strategy in which TPG Capital will commit up to $500 million of equity capital to build a leading, integrated, enterprise-focused DevOps platform company.

deals.headline: AU10TIX Announces Strong Momentum, Executive Appointment, and Customer Growth
deals.summary: ID verification platform AU10TIX received a $60 million strategic minority investment from TPG Tech Adjacencies at a $260 million post-money valuation.
deals.evidence: August 8, 2019 – AU10TIX, a global cloud-based, machine learning, ID verification and authentication platform, announced today a $60 million strategic minority investment from TPG Tech Adjacencies. The investment from TPG, which gives AU10TIX a post-money valuation of $260 million, builds on a period of significant momentum for the company.

deals.headline: TPG Sells United Family Healthcare to New Frontier Facilitating its Return to the Public Markets
deals.summary: TPG agreed to sell Chinese private healthcare operator United Family Healthcare to New Frontier Corporation at a valuation of about $1.3 billion.
deals.evidence: Beijing and Hong Kong – July 30, 2019 – TPG, a leading global alternative asset firm, today announced that it has signed a definitive agreement to sell United Family Healthcare (“UFH”), one of the largest and most recognized integrated premium private healthcare operators in China, at a valuation of approximately $1,300 million, to New Frontier Corporation (NYSE: NFC) (“NFC”), a public investment vehicle sponsored by New Frontier Group, in a mission to create China’s largest publicly listed integrated healthcare service company.

deals.headline: TPG Real Estate Partners to Acquire 75% of Témpore Properties from Sareb
deals.summary: TPG Real Estate Partners agreed to acquire 75% of Spanish residential Socimi Témpore Properties from Sareb, valuing its shares at EUR 329.5 million.
deals.evidence: Madrid, July 5, 2019 – Sareb and TPG Real Estate Partners (“TREP”), the real estate equity investment platform of alternative asset firm TPG, announced today that they have reached an agreement for TREP to acquire 75% of Témpore Properties (“Témpore”), a Spanish Real Estate Investment Trust (“Socimi”) listed on Madrid’s Alternative Stock Exchange (MAB). This indicative price per share puts a value on the shares of the company of 329.5 million euros, which is 10% above its market capitalization at the close of the MAB on July 4, 2019 and 17% higher than the original IPO value.

deals.headline: TPG Partners with Crunch Fitness
deals.summary: TPG Growth partnered with management to acquire Crunch Fitness, including its company-owned gyms and franchising business.
deals.evidence: San Francisco, Fort Worth, Texas, and New York – July 1, 2019 – TPG Growth, the middle market and growth equity platform of alternative asset firm TPG, announced today that it has partnered with company management to acquire Crunch Fitness (Crunch). Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

deals.headline: TPG Announces Investment in Harlem Capital
deals.summary: TPG agreed to make a non-controlling strategic investment in early-stage VC firm Harlem Capital Partners and commit capital to its Fund I.
deals.evidence: San Francisco and Fort Worth, Texas – June 24, 2019 – TPG, a global alternative asset firm, today announced it has signed a definitive agreement to make a non-controlling strategic investment in Harlem Capital Partners (HCP), an early-stage venture capital firm. In connection with its investment in the company, TPG will commit capital to HCP Fund I. The investment will provide HCP access to resources to help scale its business, enhance operating capabilities, and support its portfolio.

deals.headline: TPG agrees to sell Cancer Treatment Services International to Varian Medical Systems
deals.summary: TPG Growth agreed to sell Cancer Treatment Services International, part of Asia Healthcare Holdings, to Varian Medical Systems for $283 million.
deals.evidence: Mumbai and San Francisco – May 20, 2019 – TPG Growth, the middle market and growth equity platform of alternative asset firm TPG, announced today that it has signed a definitive agreement to sell Cancer Treatment Services International (CTSI) to Varian Medical Systems (NYSE: VAR) for $283 million. CTSI is part of Asia Healthcare Holdings (AHH), a healthcare operating platform founded by TPG Growth.

deals.headline: The Rise Fund Invests in Healthcare Drone Delivery Service, Zipline
deals.summary: TPG's The Rise Fund invested in medical drone delivery company Zipline.
deals.evidence: SAN FRANCISCO & HALF MOON BAY, CA, May 17, 2019 – The Rise Fund, a global impact investment fund managed by TPG Growth, today announced its investment in Zipline.

deals.headline: Asia Healthcare Holdings (AHH) acquires Nova IVI Fertility
deals.summary: TPG Growth-founded Asia Healthcare Holdings signed definitive agreements to acquire Indian IVF network Nova IVI Fertility.
deals.evidence: Mumbai; May 2 2019: Asia Healthcare Holdings (AHH), a healthcare operating platform founded by TPG Growth, has signed definitive agreements to acquire Nova IVI Fertility. Nova fertility operates India’s second largest network of IVF centres with 20 centres across 15 cities.

deals.headline: TPG-Led Consortium Invests in APM Monaco
deals.summary: A TPG-led consortium agreed to acquire 30% of jewellery brand APM Monaco from its existing shareholders.
deals.evidence: HONG KONG and BEIJING—17 April 2019 — TPG, a leading global alternative asset firm, today announced that it has led a consortium of investors and reached a definitive agreement to invest in APM Monaco (“APM” or “The Company”), a leading contemporary jewellery brand, synonymous with the chic of Monaco and South of France lifestyle. TPG and its partners will together acquire 30% of the company from its existing shareholders.

deals.headline: AskBio Partners with TPG and Vida Ventures
deals.summary: TPG Capital and Vida Ventures invested $225 million for a minority stake in gene therapy company AskBio as part of $235 million of funding.
deals.evidence: Research Triangle Park, NC; Fort Worth, Texas; San Francisco; and Boston – April 11, 2019 – Asklepios BioPharmaceutical, Inc (AskBio), a developer and manufacturer of Adeno-Associated Virus (AAV) gene therapy therapeutics for underserved patient populations with rare and generally untreatable genetic disorders, announced today $235 million in funding to augment and accelerate its business. TPG Capital and Vida Ventures are investing $225 million for a minority stake in the company. As part of the transaction, AskBio’s founders and board members are co-investing $10 million.

deals.headline: Expanse Announces $70 Million Series C Funding, Led by TPG Growth
deals.summary: Internet asset management platform Expanse raised a $70 million Series C led by TPG Growth.
deals.evidence: San Francisco, CA – April 9, 2019 – Expanse, an Internet information technology (IT) operations management platform, announced today that it has raised $70 million in Series C funding led by TPGGrowth. The round also welcomes investments from Arianna Huffington, Peter Thiel, Egon Durban, Taylor Glover, Sam Palmisano, as well as return investments from NEA, IVP, and Founders Fund.

deals.headline: New Public Benefit Corporation, Instride, launches to Reinvent the Way Employers Bring the Power of a University Education to their Employees
deals.summary: Arizona State University and TPG's The Rise Fund launched learning services public benefit corporation InStride.
deals.evidence: April 4, 2019 – Los Angeles, California – Arizona State University (ASU), recognized by U.S. News and World Report as the country’s most innovative university, and The Rise Fund, a global impact investing fund managed by TPG, have collaborated to launch InStride, a learning services enterprise designed to achieve significant social impact through partnerships with employers to provide opportunities for employees to obtain a university education.

deals.headline: TPG invests INR 100 crores in Indian beauty retailer Nykaa
deals.summary: Indian beauty retailer Nykaa raised INR 100 crore of primary investment from TPG Growth.
deals.evidence: March 27, 2019: Nykaa, India’s leading beauty retailer, raised INR 100 crores through leading private equity fund TPG Growth as primary investment.

deals.headline: Entertainment Partners Announces Investment From TPG
deals.summary: Entertainment production services company Entertainment Partners agreed to be acquired by TPG Capital.
deals.evidence: Burbank, CA, March 26, 2019 – Entertainment Partners (“EP” or the “Company”), the leading global end-to-end provider of production workforce management and automated production software and services to the entertainment industry, announced today that it has reached an agreement to be acquired by TPG Capital, the private equity platform of global alternative asset firm TPG. EP’s management team, led by Mark Goldstein, President and CEO, will continue in their roles.

deals.headline: Calm Raises $88M, Becomes First Mental Health Unicorn
deals.summary: Meditation app Calm raised an $88 million Series B led by TPG Growth at a $1 billion valuation.
deals.evidence: SAN FRANCISCO (February 6, 2019) – Calm today announced that it has raised $88 million in a Series B financing, valuing the company at $1 billion USD. The funding round is led by TPG Growth with participation from Creative Artists Agency (CAA), and existing investors Insight Venture Partners and Sound Ventures.

deals.headline: TPG Growth to Invest in Solara Active Pharma, Leading Indian Pharmaceutical Developer
deals.summary: TPG Growth agreed to invest $30 million in Indian API manufacturer Solara Active Pharma.
deals.evidence: Bangalore, India – February 4, 2019 – Today, TPG Growth announced that it would invest $30 million in Solara Active Pharma, a leading global manufacturer of active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) with a network of customers including several top global generic companies in the US and Europe and a robust selection of products.

deals.headline: TPG Capital and Lani Fritts Partner to Launch Kadiant

Kadiant is a mission-driven organization that seeks to provide high-quality Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy and related critical services to individuals diagnosed with autism spectrum disorder (ASD). TPG Capital has committed $300 million of equity capital to support Kadiant’s launch and growth strategy. Vida Ventures will invest in the platform alongside TPG Capital.

deals.headline: TPG Capital to sell Transporeon Group to Hg
deals.summary: Hg agreed to acquire a majority interest in logistics platform Transporeon from TPG Capital; terms were not disclosed.

Terms of the transaction are not being disclosed.

deals.headline: TPG Capital backs BVI to Acquire PhysIOL Group SA
deals.summary: TPG Capital-backed BVI agreed to acquire Belgian intraocular lens maker PhysIOL from TA Associates.

deals.headline: TPG Growth Acquires Q-Centrix from Sterling Partners
deals.summary: TPG Growth closed its acquisition of hospital quality data company Q-Centrix from Sterling Partners.

TPG Growth acquired the company from Sterling Partners. Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

deals.headline: ViaCyte Secures $80 Million Financing to Advance Functional Cures for Insulin-Requiring Diabetes
deals.summary: Cell therapy company ViaCyte raised an $80 million Series D led by Bain Capital Life Sciences and joined by TPG and RA Capital.

deals.headline: The Rise Fund Leads Series C Financing in CFPA Microfinance, China’s Leading Rural Microfinance Provider
deals.summary: Chinese rural microfinance provider CFPA Microfinance closed a Series C of almost RMB 1 billion (about $140 million) in primary and secondary shares, led by TPG's The Rise Fund.

The Rise Fund, a global impact investing fund managed by TPG Growth led the investment.

deals.headline: TPG Growth Leads $42 Million Equity Investment in Ess Kay Fincorp
deals.summary: TPG Growth led a $42 million equity investment in Indian commercial vehicle lender Ess Kay Fincorp alongside existing investors Norwest and Evolvence.

deals.evidence: Greencross shareholders have approved a $675 million takeover bid from US private equity firm TPG Capital. … Directors of the vet clinic operator and Pet Barn owner had unanimously recommended investors approve the $5.55 per share offer received from TPG in November.

deals.headline: Vice Media raises $450 million, bumping valuation to near $6 billion
deals.summary: Vice Media raised $450 million from TPG, which its CEO said valued the company at $5.7 billion.
deals.evidence: Vice Media announced Monday that it has raised $450 million in investment from private equity firm TPG. … Vice CEO Shane Smith told CNBC on Monday morning that the new funding puts the media company’s valuation at $5.7 billion.

deals.headline: Philz Coffee close to closing deal to sell to private equity firm for $145 million
deals.summary: Freeman Spogli & Co. was buying TPG Growth and Summit Partners-backed Philz Coffee for $145 million, according to stockholder documents.
deals.evidence: Los Angeles-based private equity firm Freeman Spogli & Co. is in the process of buying Philz Coffee for $145 million, according to documents shared with stockholders and obtained by Mission Local . … Philz board members, which include former CEO Phil Jaber and his son, Jacob Jaber; representatives from investment firms Summit Partners and TPG Growth; and CEO Mahesh Sadarangani will receive payouts or bonuses from the deal.

deals.headline: Philz Coffee close to closing deal to sell to private equity firm for $145 million
deals.summary: In 2016 Philz Coffee received a $45 million investment led by TPG.
deals.evidence: But current and former employees said that the company culture began to change in 2016 with large infusions of cash from investors, like $45 million led by TPG, a private equity company.

deals.headline: Irving Azoff’s GMR just struck a $3.3 billion private equity deal, say MBW sources
deals.summary: Hellman & Friedman struck a deal valuing Global Music Rights at $3.3 billion, with long-time co-owner TPG cashing out, according to MBW sources.
deals.evidence: MBW has confirmed via well-placed sources that Irving Azoff ‘s US-headquartered PRO, Global Music Rights (GMR) , struck a multi-billion dollar deal yesterday (September 18) with a new private equity partner. … The transaction, we’re told, valued GMR at USD $3.3 billion . … It’s understood that Azoff is maintaining a stake in the company, but TPG – his long-time co-owner in GMR – has cashed out. … It’s also understood that the buyer is a private equity firm, Hellman & Friedman, which had USD $120 billion in Assets Under Management (AUM) at the close of 2023.

deals.headline: TPG makes significant investment in BGB Group
deals.summary: TPG made a significant investment in medical communications agency BGB Group that sources said valued it at $760 million.
deals.evidence: TPG's investment values the medical communications agency at $760m, sources tell PE Hub, as growth in drug development spurs more demand for the industry's services.

deals.headline: TPG Real Estate Acquires Cinespace Studios Chicago And Toronto In $1.1B Deal
deals.summary: TPG Real Estate Partners acquired Cinespace Studios' Chicago and Toronto sound stage campuses in a deal sources put at about $1.1 billion.
deals.evidence: TPG Real Estate Partners has acquired the studio campuses of Cinespace Studios in Chicago and Toronto — combined the second largest independent sound stage platform in North America — as the buying, selling and building of sound stages continues at a fast clip. … Financial terms of the latest transaction were not disclosed but sources close to the deal pegged it at around $1.1 billion.

deals.headline: TPG Exits FirstCry With ₹202 Cr Bulk Deal
deals.summary: TPG fully exited listed kidswear company FirstCry through a Rs 202 crore bulk deal.
deals.evidence: Private equity (PE) giant TPG has exited omnichannel kids wear giant FirstCry through a ₹202 Cr bulk deal. … Notably, TPG held a 2.21% stake in FirstCry at the end of the June 2026 quarter. The PE giant first invested in the omnichannel kidswear giant in 2021, and has been gradually diluting its shareholding in the company since FirstCry’s IPO in 2024.

deals.headline: Convene Hospitality Group secures $230m in growth capital led by TPG, with additional backing from Ares
deals.summary: Convene Hospitality Group, owner of NeueHouse, secured $230 million of growth capital led by new lender TPG with equity from existing shareholders including Ares.
deals.evidence: Convene Hospitality Group (CHG) has secured $230 million in strategic growth capital, led by new lender TPG, with additional equity investment from existing shareholders, including Ares funds.

deals.headline: KKR invests $95 mn in Lenskart, TPG and TR Capital to partially exit
deals.summary: KKR invested $95 million in Lenskart through a secondary stake purchase that gave TPG Growth and TR Capital partial exits.
deals.evidence: Global private equity firm KKR on Monday announced an investment of $95 million (about Rs 695.8 crore) in omni-channel eyewear brand Lenskart through secondary stake acquisition. … The investment will create partial exits for early investors TPG Growth and TR Capital, which bet on Lenskart in 2014.

deals.headline: Nextracker begins spin-out process after US$500m stock sale
deals.summary: Flex agreed to sell US$500 million of Nextracker convertible preferred equity to TPG Rise Climate, valuing the solar tracker business at around US$3 billion.
deals.evidence: Nextracker is to be spun out from parent company Flex after it secured a US$500 million equity sale, valuing the business at around US$3 billion. … Nextracker will now begin its spin-out process from Flex after the parent group agreed to sell US$500 million of convertible preferred equity to the climate investment arm of investor TPG Rise.

deals.headline: OpenAI launches $4bn Deployment Company with TPG, Advent, Bain, and Brookfield
deals.summary: OpenAI launched the OpenAI Deployment Company with more than $4 billion of initial funding from a 19-firm syndicate led by TPG with Advent, Bain Capital and Brookfield as co-lead founding partners.
deals.evidence: OpenAI has set up a new venture called OpenAI Deployment Company, with more than $4bn in initial funding from a syndicate of 19 firms led by TPG and including Advent International, Bain Capital and Brookfield as co-lead founding partners, the company said on Monday. … The new entity, which will be majority-owned and controlled by OpenAI, has been formed to embed frontier-AI engineers inside enterprise customers and to oversee complex multi-team deployments of OpenAI’s models.

deals.headline: Super.com Raises $65 Million Series D At $1.2 Billion Valuation To Scale AI‑Powered Savings For Everyday Americans
deals.summary: Savings app Super.com raised a $65 million Series D led by TPG at a $1.2 billion valuation.
deals.evidence: Super.com, a savings “super app” aimed at everyday Americans, has raised a $65 million Series D round led by TPG at a $1.2 billion valuation.

deals.headline: Digitized ID Verification Startup, Onfido, Lands $100M
deals.summary: Identity verification company Onfido raised $100 million in a round led by TPG Growth.
deals.evidence: Identity verification startup Onfido has raised $100 million in a new round of funding. … This round, which was led by TPG Growth , brings Onfido’s total funding to $200 million, according to the company.

deals.headline: 49.9% of Big River Steel sold for $700 million in cash
deals.summary: U.S. Steel agreed to buy 49.9% of TPG Growth-backed Big River Steel for about $700 million in cash at an implied enterprise value of about $2.325 billion.
deals.evidence: United States Steel Corporation (X) (“U. S. Steel”) announced on October 1 a joint venture partnership agreement under which it has taken the first step towards acquiring Big River Steel (“Big River”) through the purchase of a 49.9% ownership interest at a purchase price of approximately $700 million in cash, with a call option to acquire the remaining 50.1% within the next four years. U. S. Steel has committed financing to execute the transaction. The implied enterprise value of Big River, including the expected completion of its Phase II-A expansion, which is fully funded and already under construction, is approximately $2.325 billion.

deals.investor: Integrated Media Company (IMC, backed by TPG)
deals.headline: DAZN agrees US$100m plus Goal.com sale to IMC
deals.summary: DAZN agreed to sell a majority stake in Goal.com, with Spox and VoetbalZone, to TPG-backed Integrated Media Company in a deal SportsPro understood valued the brands at more than US$100 million.
deals.evidence: DAZN Group, the British-based digital sports media company, has signed a definitive agreement to sell a majority stake in its soccer news website Goal.com to Integrated Media Company (IMC), a platform backed by US-based investment firm TPG. … IMC’s acquisition also includes German and Dutch digital soccer-focused platforms Spox and VoetbalZone. SportsPro understands the deal values the three brands at more than US$100 million.

deals.headline: Yoco Receives Massive Funding of $83 Million in Their Series C
deals.summary: South African payments platform Yoco raised an $83 million Series C with new investors including Dragoneer, Breyer Capital and HOF Capital.
deals.evidence: South African payments and software platform, Yoco, has secured $83 million in Series C funding amid a surge in demand for digital payments amongst African small businesses. … Among the company’s new investors are Dragoneer Investment Group, which is making its Africa investment debut, after having previously backed fintech giants like Chime, Nubank, Mercado Libre, Square and Klarna. Also joining the round were Breyer Capital, HOF Capital, The Raba Partnership, 4DX Ventures, TO Ventures and several current and former executives from global tech leaders such as Coinbase, Revolut, Spotify, and Gojek. The funding round also included existing Yoco investors Partech, Velocity Capital Fintech Ventures, Orange Ventures, Quona Capital, FMO, and Futuregrowth.

deals.headline: TPG picks up minority stake in cables manufacturer RR Kabel
deals.summary: TPG Capital acquired a significant minority stake in wire and cable maker RR Kabel and a group company in deals people familiar put at about Rs 630 crore.
deals.evidence: Private equity firm TPG Capital has acquired a significant minority stake in RR Kabel Ltd, which makes wires and low-voltage cables, and one of its group companies. … The transaction value for the twin deals is around Rs 630 crore ($88 million), people familiar with the matter said.

deals.headline: TPG Asia sells entire stake in RR Kabel in Rs 958 crore block deal
deals.summary: TPG Asia sold its remaining ~5% stake in RR Kabel through block deals worth about Rs 958 crore, fully exiting.
deals.evidence: PE firm TPG Asia on Thursday sold its entire stake in wire and cable manufacturer RR Kabel through block deals , according to exchange data. … TPG Asia offloaded about 5% stake or just over 56 lakh shares at around Rs 1,701 apiece. This valued the deal at around Rs 958 crore.

deals.headline: Livspace Raises $70 Million in Series C Funding Round Led by TPG Growth and Goldman Sachs
deals.summary: Home interiors platform Livspace closed a $70 million Series C led by TPG Growth and Goldman Sachs.
deals.evidence: Livspace today announced that it has closed a $70 million Series C funding round. The round was led by global investment funds TPG Growth and Goldman Sachs, a global investment bank and active investor in India , and included participation from existing investors Jungle Ventures, Bessemer Venture Partners and Helion Ventures.

deals.headline: Partners Group, Kedaara Capital to acquire Vishal Mega Mart from TPG
deals.summary: Partners Group and Kedaara Capital agreed to acquire Vishal Mega Mart from TPG in a deal market sources put at around Rs 5,000 crore.
deals.evidence: Private equity firms Partners Group and Kedaara Capital Fund will acquire value retail chain Vishal Mega Mart (VMM) from PE firm TPG. The deal size was not disclosed but as per market sources it is expected to be around Rs 5,000 crore.

deals.headline: UnitedHealth to grow portfolio with $2.3B Surgical Care Affiliates purchase
deals.summary: UnitedHealth Group agreed to buy Surgical Care Affiliates for about $2.3 billion, with TPG Capital affiliates agreeing to sell their 30% stake.
deals.evidence: UnitedHealth Group has announced plans to purchase Surgical Care Affiliates (SCA) for about $2.3 billion. … With a 30% stake in SCA, TPG Capital affiliates have agreed to sell its shares, Reuters reports .

deals.headline: Nextracker Announces Pricing of Upsized Initial Public Offering
deals.summary: TPG Rise Climate-backed Nextracker priced its upsized Nasdaq IPO of 26.6 million shares at $24.00 per share.
deals.evidence: SAN JOSE, Calif. , Feb. 8, 2023 /PRNewswire/ -- Flex Ltd. (NASDAQ: FLEX ) announced today that its subsidiary, Nextracker Inc. ("Nextracker"), priced its upsized initial public offering of 26,600,000 shares of its Class A common stock ("Common Stock") at an initial public offering price of $24.00 per share.

deals.headline: CeriBell, Inc. Announces Closing of Upsized Initial Public Offering and Full Exercise of the Underwriters' Option to Purchase Additional Shares
deals.summary: Rise Fund-backed Ceribell closed its upsized Nasdaq IPO at $17.00 per share for gross proceeds of about $207.3 million.
deals.evidence: SUNNYVALE, Calif. , Oct. 15, 2024 /PRNewswire/ -- CeriBell, Inc. (Nasdaq: CBLL ) ("Ceribell"), a commercial-stage medical technology company focused on transforming the diagnosis and management of patients with serious neurological conditions, announced today the closing of its upsized initial public offering of 12,196,969 shares of its common stock at a public offering price of $17.00 per share, which includes 1,590,909 shares of common stock issued upon the exercise in full by the underwriters of their option to purchase additional shares. … The total gross proceeds from the offering, before deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and other offering expenses payable by Ceribell, were approximately $207.3 million .

deals.seller: TPG, CX Partners and the founders
deals.headline: Apax buys surgical company Healthium in Rs 2,000 crore deal
deals.summary: Apax Partners agreed to acquire nearly all of Healthium MedTech for nearly $350 million, buying TPG's 73% stake along with CX Partners and the founders.
deals.evidence: BENGALURU: Buyout investor Apax Partners said it will acquire India's largest surgical and wound care products maker Healthium MedTech , formerly known as Sutures India, for nearly $350 million, or slightly over Rs 2,000 crore. TOI first reported on the impending deal in its March 5 edition. Apax will buy almost 100% shares from existing investors, which include private equity firms TPG and CX Partners with 73% and 12% respectively, and the founders led by Chandrasekhar Gopalan.

deals.headline: Integrated Media Company Buys Toon Boom Animation
deals.summary: TPG platform Integrated Media Company agreed to acquire animation software company Toon Boom from Corus's Nelvana for about CAD 147.5 million in cash.
deals.evidence: Leading Canadian media company Corus Entertainment today announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Nelvana Limited , has entered into a definitive agreement with Integrated Media Company , a TPG platform dedicated to the new media ecosystem, which will acquire Nelvana’s wholly-owned subsidiary, Montreal-based animation software company Toon Boom Animation, for approximately $147.5 million CAD in cash.

deals.headline: Classic Collision Acquires 9 Location MSO with Facilities in Georgia, South Carolina
deals.summary: TPG-owned Classic Collision acquired nine-location Kendrick Paint & Body in Georgia and South Carolina.
deals.evidence: Classic Collision has acquired Kendrick Paint & Body, adding nine collision repair facilities in Augusta, Martinez and Evans, Ga., as well as Aiken, S.C.

deals.headline: Kakao Mobility files for $1b US IPO as TPG seeks exit
deals.summary: Kakao Mobility reportedly filed confidentially for a US IPO expected to raise about $1 billion, giving the TPG-led consortium that owns about 29% a route to exit.
deals.evidence: Kakao Mobility has moved closer to a potential US stock market debut after reportedly filing confidential IPO documents with US regulators, in a listing expected to raise about $1 billion and provide an exit for its second-largest shareholder, TPG. … The consortium, Kakao Mobility’s second-largest shareholder, owns about 29 percent of the company. It invested roughly 640 billion won across two funding rounds in 2017 and 2021 but has sought an exit as its funds approach maturity and Kakao Mobility’s domestic listing remains stalled.

deals.headline: Element Markets and Bluesource Formally Merge to Create Anew™
deals.summary: TPG Rise-backed Element Markets and NGP-backed Bluesource, merged in February 2022, rebranded as climate solutions company Anew.
deals.evidence: Element Markets and Bluesource announced a new brand name today, Anew™, forming one of the largest climate solutions companies in North America. The name signifies the unification of two leaders in environmental credit marketing and origination that joined forces through a merger in February this year. The combined company, backed by TPG Rise and NGP, offers an unparalleled scope of services to a broad and diverse international client base that includes Fortune 50 companies and hundreds of other public and private organizations.

deals.headline: Beautycounter is now a $1 billion brand following Carlyle Group investment
deals.summary: The Carlyle Group acquired a majority stake in Beautycounter at a $1 billion valuation, with TPG exiting its position.
deals.evidence: On Tuesday, private equity firm The Carlyle Group acquired a majority stake in clean beauty company Beautycounter, valuing it at $1 billion. … It previously received funding from PE firm TPG, which is exiting its position following The Carlyle Group’s acquisition.

deals.headline: Ingham's Chickens shares flop then flap in IPO
deals.summary: TPG floated Australian poultry producer Ingham's on the ASX at $3.15 a share, cutting the planned raise to $596 million and selling 40 per cent of its shares.
deals.evidence: After initially flagging a price of between $3.57 to $4.14 a share, the US private equity firm ended up floating Ingham's at $3.15. … TPG then slashed the amount it planned to raise in the Ingham's listing to $596 million just last week and said 40 per cent of its shares would be sold compared to the 50 to 70 per cent planned in its initial prospectus.

deals.headline: This Chinese Bike-Share Startup Just Raised Another $215 Million
deals.summary: Chinese bike-sharing company Mobike closed a $215 million Series D led by Tencent and Warburg Pincus with new investors including TPG Capital.
deals.evidence: Chinese bike-sharing start-up Mobike has closed a $215 million series D funding round led by Tencent Holdings and Warburg Pincus LLC. … New investors include Chinese travel company Ctrip.com International, private equity firm TPG Capital and Huazhou Hotels Group, Mobike said in a statement on Wednesday.

deals.headline: TPG Agrees to Buy Learfield in Deal Worth Roughly $2 Billion
deals.summary: TPG agreed to buy college multimedia rights company Learfield in a deal a source put at roughly $2 billion.
deals.evidence: Alternative asset manager TPG has reached an agreement to buy college multimedia rights firm Learfield , according to multiple people familiar with the details. It is a roughly $2 billion deal, one of the sources said.

deals.headline: TPG buys majority stake in $3.5 billion power infrastructure firm Sabre Industries
deals.summary: TPG agreed to buy a majority stake in Sabre Industries from Blackstone in a deal sources said valued the company at around $3.5 billion.
deals.evidence: NEW YORK, Feb 6 (Reuters) – Private markets firm TPG has agreed to buy a ‍majority stake in Sabre Industries from Blackstone, the companies said on Friday, in a deal two people familiar with the matter said valued the power ‌infrastructure company at around $3.5 billion.

deals.headline: TPG Capital acquires Forcepoint's government cybersecurity business for $2.45B
deals.summary: TPG Capital agreed to acquire Forcepoint's government cybersecurity business from Francisco Partners for $2.45 billion.
deals.evidence: Buyout firm TPG Capital today said it will acquire the government business of cybersecurity company Forcepoint LLC for $2.45 billion, a figure higher than what the entirety of Forcepoint was acquired for by Francisco Partners in 2021 .

deals.target: Kepware and ThingWorx (PTC industrial connectivity and IoT businesses)
deals.portco_name: Kepware and ThingWorx (PTC industrial connectivity and IoT businesses)
deals.headline: Big tech’s big problem with IoT – as PTC sells Kepware, ThingWorx for up to $725m
deals.summary: TPG agreed to buy PTC's Kepware and ThingWorx businesses for up to $725 million, with $565-$600 million up front.
deals.evidence: Private equity firm TPG is to buy Kepware and ThingWorx from PTC for up to $725 million. … PTC could get up to $725 million for the two units, and $565-$600 million “up-front”, when the deal closes next year – on twin Industry 4.0 assets that deliver about $200 million in annual revenue.

deals.headline: PE giant TPG takes strategic stake in Creative Planning
deals.summary: TPG Capital took a minority stake in RIA Creative Planning; sources had told Reuters it was a $2 billion stake valuing the firm at more than $15 billion.
deals.evidence: While the terms of the deal revealed Monday were not disclosed, sources with knowledge of the matter previously told Reuters TPG was pursuing a $2 billion stake, with the deal reportedly valuing Creative Planning at more than $15 billion.

deals.headline: Private equity firm TPG to acquire 70% stake in Australasian largest public transport operator Kinetic
deals.summary: TPG agreed to acquire 70% of Australasian transport operator Kinetic in a deal media commentary put at an enterprise value above USD 4.0 billion.
deals.evidence: Media commentary places the enterprise value of the transaction at above USD 4.0 billion , though exact terms remain undisclosed

deals.headline: KKR agrees to buy Singapore-based XCL Education in US$1.3 billion deal: sources
deals.summary: KKR agreed to buy a majority stake in school operator XCL Education from TPG in a deal people familiar said valued it at about US$1.3 billion.
deals.evidence: [HONG KONG] KKR & Co has agreed to buy a majority stake in XCL Education Holdings in a deal that values the South-east Asian school operator at about US$1.3 billion, according to people familiar with the matter. … KKR outbid other investment firms for the stake held by TPG, the people said, without disclosing the exact size of the holding.

deals.headline: Troon acquires Indigo Golf Partners
deals.summary: Golf management company Troon acquired Indigo Golf Partners, formerly Billy Casper Golf.
deals.evidence: Scottsdale, Ariz. (January 4, 2021) – Troon ®, the leader in club management, development, and marketing, is pleased to announce it has acquired Indigo Golf Partners , the company formerly known as Billy Casper Golf.

deals.headline: Crunch Fitness Acquires Bay Area Franchise Locations, Expanding Corporate Footprint
deals.summary: Crunch Fitness acquired the eight clubs of Bay Area franchisee Bay Area Crunchers.
deals.evidence: Crunch Fitness has expanded its corporate presence in Northern California, acquiring the eight clubs operated by franchise group Bay Area Crunchers as the high-value, low-price (HVLP) gym brand continues to invest in one of its key growth markets.

deals.headline: Aareon Acquires MIS ActiveH
deals.summary: TPG-owned property software provider Aareon agreed to acquire UK social housing software provider MIS ActiveH.
deals.evidence: Aareon, a provider of SaaS solutions for the property industry in Europe, announced that it has signed an agreement to acquire MIS ActiveH, the provider of housing management solutions for registered providers in the social housing sector.

deals.headline: Clarizen Has Agreed to be Acquired by Planview
deals.summary: TPG Capital and TA Associates-backed Planview agreed to acquire Clarizen from K1 Investment Management.
deals.evidence: William Blair acted as the exclusive financial advisor to Clarizen, a portfolio company of K1 Investment Management (K1), in connection with its pending acquisition by Planview, a portfolio company of TPG Capital and TA Associates. The transaction was announced on January 12th and is anticipated to close within the next 30 days.

deals.headline: TPG-backed BGB Group acquires healthcare consultancy Kx Advisors
deals.summary: TPG-backed BGB Group acquired Washington, DC healthcare strategy consultancy Kx Advisors.
deals.evidence: BGB Group, a New York-based healthcare communications agency, has acquired Kx Advisors, a Washington, DC-based healthcare strategy consulting firm.
